gameDescriptionHtml:
Bounty hunter Samus Aran finds herself stranded on the mysterious planet Viewros, where she must use new psychic abilities and her advanced technology to find her way home while battling alien threats and a rival hunter named Sylux.

The story begins as Samus is tasked by the Galactic Federation to protect a mysterious artifact. During a clash with the enigmatic bounty hunter Sylux, an accident transports Samus to the jungle planet of Viewros, a world once home to an ancient race called the Lamorn. With her power suit’s abilities diminished, she is bestowed with new psychic powers by the remnants of the Lamorn civilization, who make a request of her in exchange for her cooperation. Samus must explore this hostile, labyrinthine world, collecting five special keys located in themed “dungeons” to activate a teleporter and escape.

Game Features

  • First-Person Exploration and Combat: The game retains the classic first-person gameplay of previous Metroid Prime titles, focusing on exploration, puzzle-solving, and shooting.
  • New Psychic Abilities: A major addition is Samus’s new psychic powers. These abilities allow her to operate mechanisms, control the trajectory of her charged beam shots, see hidden platforms, and manipulate objects in the environment.
  • Vi-O-La Vehicle: Samus acquires a technologically advanced motorcycle called the Vi-O-La, which she uses to traverse the large, open desert hub world (Sol Valley) between the main dungeon areas.
  • Scanning and Upgrades: Players must use Samus’s Scan Visor to gather information on the environment, lifeforms, and puzzles, which is essential for progression. The game also features returning staples like the Morph Ball and various beam upgrades.
  • Atmosphere and Isolation: The game aims to blend atmospheric, isolated exploration within its intricate dungeons with occasional, more character-focused moments involving accompanying Galactic Federation troopers.
